name: Shiawase na Ohime-sama ~Engage wa Kozukuri no Tame ni~
original_name: しあわせなお姫さま～エンゲージは子づくりのために～
source:
Ritz is an ordinary boy, living a peaceful life. But he is actually a descendant of a royal family! One day, he is surprised to know the fact and he is offered to be next king since the former king passed away a few days ago. He doesn't know what's going on, but he is taken to a palace. He is astonished to hear that he will need to marry in a month....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090118221436/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1008841]ErogeShop.com[/url]]
translation:
里茲只是個過著平靜生活的普通少年，其實卻是王室後裔！一天，他驚訝地得知這一事實；由於前任國王幾天前剛剛去世，他也被推舉為下一任國王。還沒弄清究竟發生了什麼，里茲就被帶進王宮。更令他震驚的是，他必須在一個月內結婚……
